definitions.explanation: Food prepared by simmering in seasoned liquid (typically dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sake). A fundamental Japanese cooking method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肉|にく}じゃが→肉じゃが：17620_nikujaga⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{煮物|にもの}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Today's dinner is nikujaga and simmered vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煮物|にもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{染|し}みています→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother's simmered dishes are well-seasoned throughout.

examples.japanese: {煮物|にもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{作|つく}ると→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Simmered dishes are delicious when you take time to make them.

examples.japanese: {煮物|にもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|さ}める→冷める：02114_sameru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{染|し}み{込|こ}む→染み込む：07893_shimikomu⟧。
examples.english: Simmered dishes absorb flavor as they cool down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煮物|にもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ったら→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{染|し}みて→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: When I made a simmered dish of daikon and chicken, the dashi soaked in well and it was popular with my family.

notes:
{煮物|にもの} is one of the fundamental Japanese cooking methods (⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧ = to simmer/boil).

Common types:
- ⟦{肉|にく}じゃが→肉じゃが：17620_nikujaga⟧ (meat and potatoes)
- ⟦{筑前煮|ちくぜんに}→筑前煮：08602_chikuzenni⟧ (chicken and vegetables)
- ⟦{里芋|さといも}→里芋：14462_satoimo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮|に}っ{転|ころ}がし→煮っ転がし：noentry⟧ (simmered taro)
- ⟦かぼちゃ→かぼちゃ：10306_kabocha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煮物|にもの} (simmered pumpkin)

Seasoning base:
- ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (dashi stock)
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce)
- ⟦{味醂|みりん}→味醂：04918_mirin⟧ (mirin)
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar)
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (sake)

Related cooking methods:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧ (grilled)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧ (fried)
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{物|もの}→蒸し物：04978_mushimono⟧ (steamed)
